title: DeepAI Code router for DeepSeek Harness
description: DeepSeek Harness model providers that add their own routing layer: capability-ordered model ladders with automatic, per-turn failover.

plugins.name: dsh-deepaicode-auto
plugins.title: DeepAI Code router
plugins.description: Registers the DeepAI Code model catalog as the "DeepAI Code" provider and adds the virtual "Auto (DeepAiCode)" model: Frontier models first, unmetered models when the daily credit allowance is spent, hot failover on every upstream failure, and an SSE idle watchdog so a stalled stream never drops a turn.
plugins.author: Lucio Merlo
